title: Living in the Present Glory with Psalm 91
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he delves into the life-changing power of Psalm 91, exploring how living in the present glory of God's presence can shield you from life's dangers and empower you to overcome adversity. In this sermon, Pastor Zehner reveals the secrets of dwelling in the secret place of the Most High and trusting in God's unshakeable refuge. Don't miss this inspiring message of hope and victory!
